summary: Frozen Namespace value object for table locations: path (tuple of schema levels) and an explicit catalog, both defaulting to the connection's current location. Provides is_default, dotted and Namespace.coerce() for None, str, tuple or Namespace input; NamespaceLike is the accepted union type.
extension_points: Each backend renders a Namespace to its native qualified form; rendering is deliberately kept out of this module.
lifecycle_notes: Empty path segments are rejected in __post_init__ with ValueError.
A bare string coerces to a one-level path and a tuple to a multi-level path; the catalog is never inferred from tuple position.
documentation_hooks: Explain path vs. catalog and why the catalog is always explicit.
Show the accepted NamespaceLike forms on list_tables/inspect_table.

evidence.detail: Re-exported by mountainash_data.core and the package root
